high_level_description: The image depicts a large flock of flamingoes gathered closely together on what appears to be a wetland or marshy area. The background is a deep blue, suggesting the presence of water, which is typical for wetlands. The flamingoes are clustered tightly, filling most of the frame, and their white feathers stand out against the dark blue backdrop. The text at the bottom of the image provides context: "Flamingoes are seen in huge numbers behind NRI colony in Talawe wetland, Nerul, during nationwide lockdown due to Coronavirus, on April 18, 2020 in Mumbai, India."
